title: Construction of Pole Cancellation Functions at Ordinary Poles of Operator-Valued Functions
summary: A pole of order $m \in \mathbb{N}$ at $β\in \mathbb{C}$ of a regular operator valued function $Q : \mathcal{D}(Q) \to \mathcal{L}(\mathcal{H})$ is investigated. We provide a characterization of pole cancellation functions $\boldsymbolψ(z)$ of $Q(z)$ of order $k \le m$ at $β$ in terms of the coefficients of the Laurent expansion of $Q$. This characterization yields practical and explicit constructions of pole cancellation functions $\boldsymbolψ(z)$.
